name: 80004 · Arvada, CO
findings: ZIP 80004 (Arvada) has 101 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 80004 (Arvada) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 80004 (Arvada) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 41 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.
